Make the foreground creature cluster an attractive readable visual focal point in the middle-lower region, between 45%-73% of image height, comfortably inside the central 70% width. Keep the bottom 18% relatively simple and darker for website text overlay; do not place the important creatures at the extreme bottom where UI would cover them.
